title: Nearly minimal maxima and positive minima of Littlewood polynomials
coverage:
I read all seven sections in full (introduction, spreading, packing, sampling, correction, rounding, completion) and checked each step of the proof chain.

Spreading (Prop 2.1): checked the binary recursion energy identity, the 7/32 coefficient, the determinant tuning, the box count, and the final bounds on ||F||_inf, ||F||_2, the total width and K_delta.

Signed packing: checked the width slack, the degree/codegree setup and the matching size H ~ q/(2L).

Sampling: checked the Poisson summation and stationary-phase phases (x_{beta,l}, omega), that the arcs I_{a,h} are disjoint, the exact mass identity, and the gap-measure bound L <= 10 delta (numerically about 5.6 delta).

Correction (the new part):
- Phase matching on strips of width N^{-3/4}: error O(N w^2 + w).
- Lower bound 3/8 off the strips and b - o(1) on them.
- The slot argument: s_j = l_j/(4L) gives curvature >= 1/(4L), so a stationary pair costs O(sqrt(L/N)).
- The outer-slope budget, and the first-derivative bound for non-stationary middle pieces.
- Reality of the Fourier coefficients.
- Exterior tail: lower bound on |V| for k<0 and k>=N, boundary cancellation of the first integration by parts at joins, at transition endpoints and at the reflection points 0 and +-1/2, the second integration by parts, and the sum O_delta(N^{-1/4}).

Rounding: checked the Lovett-Meka threshold (sum exactly u/16), the dyadic mass argument s_j <= 2^j mu, the f(s) bounds, and the grid-to-circle Bernstein/Cauchy step (pi*e/20 ~ 0.427 < 1).

Completion: checked the rescaling into [-1,1], the defect q_delta = 4 delta + 2D sqrt(delta), monotonicity of q log(80/q), and the limits 1/8 and 1.

External theorems (Pippenger-Spencer via Alon-Yuster, Lovett-Meka Thm 4) were used as black boxes; their quoted forms match the standard statements.
main_claim: For every eta>0 and all N>=N_0(eta) there is a Littlewood polynomial of length N with sqrt(N)/16 <= |P(z)| <= (1+eta) sqrt(N) on |z|=1.
sibling_notes: The family 076 board was empty when I started. The spreading, packing, sampling and rounding sections reproduce the companion paper OpenAIMinimal, and all of them check out here. Siblings auditing that companion can reuse this: the rounding lemma, with its constant 80N/mu and grid of 20N points, is correct as stated. The only new ingredient in this paper is Prop 5.1 (the correction), which I verified in full.
